Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.
articles.titleCn: 评估计算社会科学中文本标注的决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 计算社会科学越来越多地依赖大型语言模型进行文本标注，而当前已发表研究成果的有效性则取决于这些模型生成的标签。决策模型是为分类式问答任务构建的新型模型类别，它以选择、标签集上的概率分布和置信度评分的方式回答类型化问题，而非自由文本，其成本仅为前沿推理价格的极小部分。然而，这些模型的答案是否准确，以及所声称的置信度是否能在社会科学构念上得到信任，目前尚不清楚。在此，我们复制了Ziems等人（2024）在18项计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个条目）上的评估，比较了首个商业决策模型与两个开放权重对应模型，在相同的零样本协议下，与19个前沿和开放权重语言模型进行对比。决策模型在15项评估任务中的14项上落后于每项任务的最佳LLM，中位数差距为11.6个宏观F1分，但成本中位数仅为前沿模型的44倍。其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个的口头置信度，但三个前沿模型的中位数校准误差更低（0.157对比0.066）。虽然置信度超过0.9的条目通常能被准确标注（中位数准确度为0.815），但在一项任务——同伴支持对话中的共情识别任务上，该模型报告了高置信度，但表现接近随机水平。尽管如此，我们的结果表明，决策模型在标注流程中可作为第一步：将低置信度条目路由至LLM，在四分之一至一半的成本下，其效果与单独使用LLM相当或更优。

articles.title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
articles.abstract: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.
articles.titleCn: 迈向概念统一数学
articles.abstractCn: 概念通常被定义为知识的抽象、紧凑的表征，并被视为智能行为的基本单元。然而，认知科学、心理学和人工智能在它们之间缺乏一种共享的数学语言。现代系统将概念表示为向量、分布、符号、图和其他结构，但这些形式化通常被视为相互竞争而非共同问题的解决方案。我们提出了一种基于操作的视角，通过评估数学框架所支持的概念操作来评价这些框架，并识别出在认知科学、心理学和人工智能中反复出现的十三种操作（包括相似性、组合、泛化、接地等）。我们表明，十个框架对概念的不同承诺体现在自包含内容、关系结构或演化过程上，而这些承诺决定了每个框架自然支持哪些操作。例如，基于向量的模型促进了分级相似性和泛化，但在显式组合方面表现不佳，而符号模型支持组合但泛化能力较差。我们考察的框架中没有单一框架能自然支持所有操作而不需扩展。我们通过将分类作为案例研究，对九种理论进行实证检验，这些理论在相同项目上操作化，并与人类判断进行对比。尽管这些理论都在解决相同的概念问题，但它们产生了不同的程序和结果，证明了数学承诺决定了理论能解释的内容。我们呼吁采用混合形式化方法，将内容、关系和过程视为共同的基本要素。

articles.title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
articles.abstract: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.
articles.titleCn: Minstral大语言模型的QLoRA微调用于序列到功能的蛋白质注释
articles.abstractCn: 新测序蛋白质的功能注释仍然是分子生物学中的一个瓶颈：公共数据库中的序列数量增长速度远超手动整理的能力。大多数计算方法将注释视为在固定本体上的多标签分类，这限制了预测范围仅限于预定义的标签集。在这项工作中，我们将蛋白质注释研究为一个序列到文本生成的任务。我们使用QLoRA（4位NF4量化与低秩适配器）对3B参数的Minstral 3基础模型进行微调，用于序列注释对。我们使用LLM作为专家的协议评估预测结果：将GPT模型提示为高级分子生物学策展人，对生物体识别进行二元评分，并对功能注释质量进行评估。我们得出结论，经过QLoRA微调的紧凑型LLM可以为蛋白质的很大一部分生成具有真实生物学价值的策展风格注释。我们还讨论了在数据质量、模型扩展和证据基础方面需要未来努力的方向，以确保该方法在实际应用中足够可靠。

articles.title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
articles.abstract: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.
articles.titleCn: LLJ卡片：作为评判者使用LLM的最佳实践
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为评估任务中的一种流行替代方案。这些系统通常被称为“作为评判者的LLMs”（LLJs），由于它们相对于人工判断所具有的强大性能、可扩展性和成本效益，已被研究人员和从业者广泛应用于各种测量任务。然而，越来越多的研究表明，使用LLJs作为评估者引发了对其有效性和可靠性的担忧。现有的应对这些挑战的努力主要集中在开发缓解偏见的技术和改进提示策略。虽然这些方法代表了重要的进步，但它们主要提供技术解决方案，而未能解决一个更根本的挑战：缺乏标准化的、透明的和可复现的评估实践。在本文中，我们介绍了LLJ卡片（LLJ Cards），这是一个框架，它综合了测量理论、自然语言生成和机器学习文献中的最佳实践，为基于LLJs的评估提供了实用指南。虽然LLJs为可扩展的评估提供了一条有前景的道路，但它们的有效使用需要基于严格的评估原则，以确保有效性和可靠性，并实现可复现性。LLJ卡片通过提供一个结构化的框架来应用这些原则，从而在自动化评估的设计和报告中解决了这一需求。

articles.title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
articles.abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.
articles.titleCn: Fathom-Vaidya：基于评分标准的奖励机制推动医学推理发展
articles.abstractCn: 在医疗保健领域部署大型语言模型（LLMs）需要在两个互补的维度上具备稳健的性能——诊断推理：从临床数据中推断患者病情以生成诊断的收敛性、循证任务，以及临床医疗推理：在多轮临床交互中所需的更广泛的导航性判断，以进行沟通、规划和调整，而可能并不存在唯一正确的答案。最近的基准测试如HealthBench和MedXpertQA揭示了这两个领域的持续弱点，暴露了复杂诊断场景中的失败以及以患者为中心的情境对话中的局限性。我们引入了一个顺序训练框架，利用合成数据和基于评分标准的强化学习来针对这些方面进行训练。首先，我们使用MedBullets衍生的问题，通过规则和评分标准的引导强化学习（RL）来改进诊断推理。然后，我们转向临床推理，通过生成5.3k个合成多轮场景，每个场景都配有多维评分标准，以全面评估响应。这种方法在MedXpertQA上提高了10%以上，我们的30B模型在HealthBench-Hard上达到了50.1%的准确率，超越了包括GPT-5（思考）在内的专有基线。我们的结果表明，有针对性的合成数据集和基于评分标准的训练可以系统地提高医疗LLMs的诊断和交互式临床推理能力。

articles.title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.
articles.titleCn: 1% 的 Token 就足够了：关于策略蒸馏中的梯度估计
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将教师监督分配给学生生成的轨迹中一小部分标记。然而，有用的教师指导在从采样的下一个标记估计梯度时会产生噪声更新。我们在信息几何的固定前缀处研究此估计问题，并提出基于信噪比分解的信息效率比（IER）。IER在最优标量基线下表征相对梯度估计误差。候选集近似方法基于IER选择标记，并将其与现有的有用性分数结合，同时保留采样的反向KL训练目标。在数学和医学推理任务中，添加IER在多种设置中改进了现有的选择器，稀疏配置在0.1%--1%的小标记预算下匹配或超过全OPD而无需标记选择。这些结果支持在分配稀疏监督时同时考虑有用性和梯度估计可靠性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD获取。

articles.title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
articles.abstract: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.
articles.titleCn: 端到端约旦方言语音转文本自监督学习框架
articles.abstractCn: 当今，语音转文本引擎在不同应用中需求极为迫切，它们是人类与机器人交互的关键技术。然而，一些语言缺乏标注语音数据，尤其是阿拉伯方言或低资源语言。研究表明，自监督训练过程和利用噪声数据进行自训练是新兴的可行解决方案之一。本文提出了一种基于Transformer的端到端模型，并构建了一个适用于低资源语言的框架。此外，该框架集成了定制化的音频转文本处理算法，以实现高效的约旦阿拉伯方言语音转文本系统。该框架能够整合来自多个数据源，通过加速人工标注过程，实现外部数据源的真实标签获取。该框架支持使用噪声学生训练和自监督学习，在预训练和后训练阶段利用未标记数据，并结合多种数据增强方法。所提出的自训练方法在词错误率降低方面比微调的Wav2Vec模型提高了5%。这项工作为研究界提供了一份约旦口语数据集，以及一种处理低资源语言的端到端方法。这是通过利用预训练、后训练的力量，并结合噪声标记和增强数据，以最小化人工干预来实现的。它能够推动阿拉伯语言语音转文本领域的新应用开发，如问答系统和智能控制系统，并为智能机器人增添类似人类的感知和听觉传感器。

articles.title: URA-NER: A Unified Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Retrieval Alignment and Uncertainty Reduction for Low-Resource NER
articles.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

articles.titleCn: URA-NER：一种具有检索对齐和不确定性降低的统一检索增强框架，适用于低资源命名实体识别
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的情境学习（ICL）在缓解命名实体识别（NER）中因标注数据有限而导致的性能瓶颈方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法仍面临检索错位和生成不确定等问题，其性能严重依赖于LLM的能力。随着LLM参数规模的减小，其在小样本设置下的性能显著下降。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的统一检索增强框架URA-NER，包含三个关键组件：渐进粒度检索（PGR）、模型感知表示增强（MaRE）和推理感知知识验证。PGR是一种两阶段检索机制，实现阶段对齐。它首先基于查询的全局语义检索用于跨度检测的示例，然后基于特定实体上下文检索用于类型分类，提供细粒度的局部信息。此外，MaRE采用实体预识别来指导表示的构建，确保查询和示例在LLM的语义空间和注意力模式中对齐。此外，为缓解生成不确定性，我们提出了RaKV，一个闭环的“生成-检索-验证”过程。它阐明LLM的推理路径，利用这些路径检索外部知识，并将知识重新组织为与原始推理路径对齐的验证证据。我们在多个低资源NER数据集上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，URA-NER显著提升了LLM在低资源设置下的性能，尤其对较小的LLM效果显著，在多个基准测试中取得了新的最先进结果。

articles.title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
articles.abstract: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.
articles.titleCn: 通过多维量化与推理增强缓解跨领域命名实体识别中的实体类型混淆
articles.abstractCn: 跨域命名实体识别（CD-NER）旨在将源域中的丰富知识迁移到目标域。近期采用分解或生成范式的研宄显著提升了性能，在实体跨度检测上展现出高精度。然而，在实体类型分类时，模型严重受到实体类型混淆的影响，即模型将文本中的某一类型实体错误地分类为另一相似但不正确的类型。为解决这一问题，我们首先提出一个多维混淆量化模型（MCQM），从源-目标层次分析、语义相似性分析和显式数据评估三个维度量化模型在实体类型间的混淆程度。此外，我们提出了渐进式双向推理链（PBRC）。PBRC利用源-目标层次和MCQM的混淆分析来提示大语言模型生成两阶段推理信息。该两阶段推理信息用于增强模型知识，显著缓解实体类型混淆并提升模型的泛化性能。实验结果表明，我们的方法在CrossNER数据集的所有域上均取得了新的最先进结果。

articles.title: Morpho-VITS: Variational Inference with Morphological Modeling for End-to-End Speech Synthesis of a Tonal Bantu Language
articles.abstract: Text-to-speech models for Bantu tonal languages are challenged by a tonal system that is rooted in both the lexis (i.e., the inventory of words, stems, and affixes) and the grammar (i.e., morpho-syntax). To complicate matters, the standard writing systems of these languages often omit tone markings and syllable duration information, which must be disambiguated by the reader based on context. Motivated by linguistic descriptions of Bantu language tone systems, we propose an end-to-end text-to-speech model that augments the text encoding mechanism with a morpho-syntactic prior. We replace the standard phoneme encoder in the VITS architecture with a morpheme sequence encoder and a phoneme-to-morpheme attention network. We posit that, by using this explicit morphological modeling, we can capture the information required to produce the correct tone. Experiments conducted on the Kinyarwanda language, a tonal and morphologically complex Bantu language, reveal substantial TTS improvement from this morphological modeling. Specifically, the proposed method significantly improves the naturalness, intonation, and intelligibility of the produced synthetic voices.
articles.titleCn: 形态-VITS：用于声调班图语端到端语音合成的形态建模变分推理
articles.abstractCn: 班图语调语言中的文本到语音模型面临着一项挑战：其调音系统根植于词汇（即单词、词干和词缀的库存）和语法（即形态句法）之中。更复杂的是，这些语言的标准书写系统通常省略调音符号和音节持续时间信息，这些信息必须由读者根据上下文进行消除歧义。受班图语调系统的语言描述启发，我们提出了一种端到端的文本到语音模型，该模型通过添加形态句法先验来增强文本编码机制。我们用词素序列编码器和音素到词素注意力网络替换了VITS架构中的标准音素编码器。我们假设，通过使用这种显式的形态建模，我们可以捕获产生正确调音所需的信息。在基尼亚鲁瓦达语（一种调音复杂且形态复杂的班图语言）上的实验表明，这种形态建模带来了实质性的文本到语音改进。具体而言，该方法显著提高了合成语音的自然度、语调和可懂度。

articles.title: SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration
articles.abstract: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding pretrained PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non-monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit-weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature. Across MedMCQA and MathQA, SupportCal yields lower ECE than the agreement-only baseline for nearly all evaluated target-model configurations; supplementary TweetEval Sentiment results show the same pattern on a fixed-label classification task.
articles.titleCn: SupportCal：基于参考支持和相互印证的无标签校准方法，用于预训练LLM的微调
articles.abstractCn: 训练后通常会提升任务性能，但会降低置信度校准，导致训练后语言模型（PoLM）比相应的预训练语言模型（PLM）更过度自信。由于特定任务的标记校准数据可能成本高昂或无法获取，相应的预训练PLM为事后校准提供了一个自然的无标签参考。先验协议门控PLM参考校准仅使用PoLM及其PLM参考一致的示例来拟合标量温度，排除不一致的示例，因为直接对齐可能导致拟合的温度过高并诱导低置信度。我们重新审视这种二元处理。一项受控的重新引入诊断揭示了一个非单调的总体效应：承认一部分不一致的示例可以改善校准，而随着单位权重纳入接近全部不一致集，收益会减少。我们引入了SupportCal，这是一种无标签的事后方法，它将一致示例保留为单位权重，并根据自基PLM的相对支持和从大小兼容候选池中选择的预训练参考提供的佐证，为不一致示例分配连续权重。我们进一步描述了当得到的加权目标存在有限最优温度时的情况。在MedMCQA和MathQA上，SupportCal在几乎所有评估的目标模型配置中都产生了比仅一致基线更低的ECE；补充的TweetEval情感结果在一个固定标签分类任务上显示了相同模式。

articles.title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
articles.abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.
articles.titleCn: 采样前的结构：面向数据高效文本到语音的社区感知核心集选择
articles.abstractCn: 文本到语音（TTS）语料库的录制成本高昂，但许多话语所包含的音素信息有限。核心集选择通过在固定的音频时长预算下选择一个小型训练子集来降低这一成本。我们将语料库表示为一个音位图，该图将每个话语与其音位上最相似的话语连接起来，并首先测试该图是否具有结构。在孟加拉语和英语语料库中，其聚类系数是同等规模的随机图的199倍和56倍，其模块度是保持度数的随机图的2倍以上。然后，我们提出了社区代表（Community Representative），这是一个在图社区中采样并在每个社区内扩散其选择的选取器，从包含稀有音素丰富的话语开始。在每种语言和每个预算下，它都比随机选择和基于熵的选择覆盖更多的稀有音素二元组，这一优势在保留话语中也成立。在20%的核心集上训练的TTS模型，其字符错误率（CER）在两种语言中都显著低于在同等时长的随机子集或基于熵的子集上训练的模型。当所有模型训练相同数量的轮次时，孟加拉语核心集模型也优于完整语料库训练（3.93% vs. 4.47% CER），且训练时间减少了4.5倍。

articles.title: Canonical Procedural Actions: An Auditable Annotation Protocol for Tool-Use Agent Traces
articles.abstract: Tool-use agent traces identify messages and API calls, but procedural analyses also need explicit units of action and inspectable links to their evidence. We present Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs), an annotation protocol that records a procedural function, its first agent-event anchor, the agent events that realize it, and separate contextual evidence. Multiple actions may share a message anchor without an inferred within-message order. A retail case study produces a versioned 24-entry codebook through open induction, recorded consolidation, and successive application audits. Two isolated LLM contexts annotate 32 trajectories disjoint from development at the trajectory level, producing 499 and 491 occurrences with anchor-label overlap A=0.982. Requiring identical context-event references reduces overlap to 0.798. These are structural repeatability measures, not semantic accuracy: 16 of 26 task IDs also occur in development, and historical tool payloads were truncated to 110 characters. Retrospective controls show that collapsing all labels raises overlap to 0.986, while simple endpoint rules reproduce the tool-anchored portion with 0.997 overlap. Assistant-message actions have 0.971 overlap, with a per-label minimum of 0.816. Applying the frozen codebook to 244 further trajectories yields 4,058 records, including eight diagnostic outcomes. The contribution is an explicit, auditable annotation instrument and a case study of its construction and measurement limits; human-reference validity and downstream utility remain to be established.

articles.titleCn: 规范程序动作：用于工具使用代理轨迹的可审计注释协议
articles.abstractCn: 工具使用代理追踪可识别消息和API调用，但程序分析还需要明确的行为单元及其可检查的证据链。我们提出了规范程序动作（CPA），这是一种记录程序功能、其首个代理事件锚点、实现该功能的代理事件以及独立上下文证据的标注协议。多个动作可共享消息锚点，而无需推断消息内的顺序。一项零售案例研究通过开放归纳、记录整合和连续应用审计，生成了一个包含24个条目的版本化代码簿。两个独立的LLM上下文对32个轨迹进行标注，这些轨迹在轨迹级别上与开发过程互不相干，产生了499次和491次出现，其锚点标签重叠度A=0.982。要求相同的上下文事件引用将重叠度降低至0.798。这些是结构重复性指标，而非语义准确性：26个任务ID中的16个也出现在开发过程中，且历史工具有效载荷被截断为110个字符。回顾性控制显示，合并所有标签将重叠度提高到0.986，而简单的端点规则以0.997的重叠度重现了工具锚定部分。助手消息动作的重叠度为0.971，每个标签的最小重叠度为0.816。将冻结的代码簿应用于244个进一步轨迹产生了4,058条记录，包括八个诊断结果。这项贡献是一种明确、可审计的标注工具及其构建和测量限制的案例研究；人类参考有效性和下游效用仍有待确立。

articles.title: Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science. Using a dual evaluation method - numeric margin-based scoring and semantic similarity assessment - Taramandal-GPT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models, with notable strength in thinking-intensive tasks. These results highlight the value of specialized LLMs for domains demanding accuracy and interpretability, positioning Taramandal-GPT as a step toward reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for astrophysics, spacecraft engineering, and space exploration.

articles.titleCn: Taramandal-GPT：通过知识检索和结构化思维增强天体动力学问题解决能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言理解方面取得了显著进展，但在天文学和天体动力学等专门领域，由于在多步推理、符号操作和领域特定术语方面的挑战，其有效性仍然有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Taramandal-GPT（星座-GPT），这是一个基于Qwen3-8b主干构建的领域自适应框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）流程和回退机制增强了上下文精确性。我们在天体动力学问题基准（APBench）上对其进行了评估，该数据集包含299个涵盖空间科学基础到高级水平的问题。采用双重评估方法——基于数值边界的评分和语义相似度评估——Taramandal-GPT在开源和闭源模型中取得了具有竞争力的表现，并在需要大量思考的任务中表现出显著优势。这些结果表明，专门的大型语言模型对于需要准确性和可解释性的领域具有重要价值，将Taramandal-GPT定位为迈向可靠人工智能（AI）助手的重要一步，服务于天体物理学、航天器工程和太空探索领域。

articles.title: Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models
articles.abstract: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

articles.titleCn: 记忆与语境？语言模型事实性回忆的影响因素
articles.abstractCn: 我们复现并进行了压力测试，验证了Yu等人（2023）的研究成果，该研究分析了语言模型（LMs）如何在已记忆的知识与矛盾的环境陈述之间进行权衡。我们在Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3和Minstral系列共31个模型上复现了他们的世界首都实验，包括基础模型和预训练变体，并将评估扩展到ParaConflict数据集中的五种额外知识关系类型。我们通过实证研究证实了他们大部分原始发现：较大的模型和更高频的实体倾向于优先选择记忆中的答案，且存在显著的家族级别差异。然而，一些结论并未完全普适：在Qwen3-14B和32B上，实体频率效应消失；预训练过程在不同家族间对记忆-上下文权衡的影响不一致；仅改变提问方式即可使模型对记忆知识的依赖程度变化高达80个百分点；语义上不相关的散文也能模拟出连贯的支持性上下文。我们的结果明确了Yu等人结论的有效范围及其对其他提示的普适程度。

articles.title: From Articles to Publishers: Aggregating Language Model Predictions for News Source Reliability Inference
articles.abstract: Traditionally, the reliability of news publishers is assessed by expert organisations that evaluate editorial practices, transparency and factual standards at source. When this process is translated into a computational approach, the problem is often formulated at the level of individual articles, with models being trained on a set of pre-labelled articles and their performance being evaluated in a test phase. In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems (TCSS)
articles.titleCn: 从文章到出版商：聚合语言模型预测以进行新闻来源可靠性推断
articles.abstractCn: 传统上，新闻发布者的可靠性由专业机构通过评估其编辑实践、透明度和信息来源标准来评定。当这一过程转化为计算方法时，问题通常被简化到单个文章层面，模型在预先标记的文章集上进行训练，并在测试阶段评估其性能。在本工作中，我们将新闻来源可靠性推断视为一个来源层面的预测问题。我们提出一个两阶段框架：基于transformer的语言模型首先估计单个文章的可靠性，随后将文章层面的预测结果聚合起来，以推断先前未见过的发布者的可靠性。为了近似真实的部署条件，我们强制执行严格的发布者互斥评估协议，确保没有发布者同时出现在训练集和测试集中。在19,476篇政治新闻文章（来自439家英文发布者，并标记有NewsGuard可靠性评级）上的实验表明，聚合显著提高了鲁棒性和性能，将准确性从文章层面的约0.60提升到发布者层面的0.69。最后，我们分析了预测误差如何随政治立场变化，揭示了政治倾向与错误分类模式之间存在统计学上的显著关联。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，仅通过聚合文本信号即可推断发布者可靠性，支持可扩展和基于内容的方法用于自动化新闻来源评估。

articles.title: Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations
articles.abstract: Evaluation benchmarks for Indian language automatic speech recognition (ASR) suffer from two systematic biases: optimistic scores from clean, controlled audio conditions, and pessimistic scores from overly rigid transcription standards that penalize valid linguistic variations. We introduce Vimarsha, a 100-hour benchmark spanning all 22 scheduled Indian languages, designed to address both distortions. Vimarsha combines demographically diverse on-field recordings with carefully mined in-the-wild audio selected for acoustic difficulty, alongside a lattice of variations framework that encodes multiple valid transcriptions per utterance. Evaluations of 10 state-of-the-art ASR models reveal substantial shifts in model rankings under realistic conditions, geographic and demographic performance disparities, and systematic failure modes across speaking rates and acoustic environments.
articles.titleCn: Vimarsha：针对印度语言进行忠实于现实的语音识别评估，涵盖人口多样性、自然语音和拼写变化
articles.abstractCn: 印度语言自动语音识别（ASR）评估基准存在两种系统性偏差：来自干净、受控音频条件下的乐观评分，以及来自过于僵化的转录标准下的悲观评分，这些标准会惩罚有效的语言变异。我们引入Vimarsha，这是一个涵盖全部22种法定印度语言的100小时基准，旨在解决这两种扭曲。Vimarsha结合了人口统计学多样化的现场录音与精心挖掘的、具有声学难度的自然场景音频，并辅以一个编码每条语音多个有效转录的变体框架。对10个最先进的ASR模型的评估揭示了在真实条件下模型排名的显著变化、地理和人口统计表现差异，以及在说话速率和声学环境方面的系统性失效模式。

articles.title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models
articles.abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.
articles.titleCn: LoopCD：一种用于提升循环语言模型推理能力的循环对比解码方法
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）通过递归地使用共享权重优化内部潜在表示来实现“潜在推理”，为显式语言推理提供了一种更有效的替代方案。尽管它们效果显著，但我们发现LoopLMs仍然容易受到循环不稳定性问题的影响：迭代过程中的不稳定优化会产生与推理错误相关的局部不确定“硬”标记。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LoopCD，即循环对比解码方法，通过在推理时干预这些标记来提升LoopLMs的推理性能。具体而言，我们利用LoopLMs的内部动态特性，将早期迭代的logits与最后一次优化迭代的logits进行对比，从而形成最终的采样分布。我们发现该策略效率极高，仅引入微不足道的推理开销，无需额外训练，同时通过自然地优化推理关键硬标记，有效提升了推理性能。大量实验表明，我们的方法能够显著提升近期代表性LoopLMs在各种推理任务上的表现。

articles.title: When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits
articles.abstract: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.
articles.titleCn: 当残差化有助于审计：格式效应、切片收益及其局限性
articles.abstractCn: 围绕大型语言模型（LLM）系统的评估分数——包括奖励模型、重新排序器和LLM评判器——可能追踪表面形式而非其声称衡量的质量。当同时呈现一个简洁的正确解决方案和一个带注释的缺陷解决方案来解决同一个MBPP问题时，一个公开偏好奖励模型选择正确方案的概率与抛硬币无异（0.507）。从这类分数中减去可预测的表面成分的做法越来越普遍，但仅去除该成分并不能得到更有效的测量：被移除的成分可能携带与结构相关的信号，而残差化无法区分哪些是哪些。在设计的干预措施下——使用仅含注释的单元测试标签编辑——残差化通过约0.12的幅度减弱了奖励模型对格式效应的影响，同时正确与缺陷代码之间的差距变化小于0.01。在观察性NLI和QA设置中，我们在评分前冻结一个保留的复制版本，并使用来自不同标注者的标签重新评估它；这仅支持一个较窄的结论：在表面预测器出错的预先声明切片中，与结构标签的更好一致性，而非修复后的分数。在所有观察性设置中，当报告存在正向切片增益时，全人群一致性均下降，且在所有此类QA设置中，问题内排名均下降。当结构与表面特征交织在一起时，残差化可能去相关化分数，但会降低结构一致性，在受控模型中，对结构一致性造成同等损害的配置会通过所有预先调整检查，因此没有承诺的关卡是保证。我们将这些区别汇编成一个报告协议，其结果——包括拒绝——声明调整后的分数可能表明什么：一个审计时诊断，附带其造成结构一致性成本，永远不会取代原始分数。

articles.title: Efficient LLM Distillation for Bangladesh Legal Context: A Smartphone-Compatible Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model
articles.abstract: Legal information in Bangladesh is inaccessible to most citizens. Statutory text is English-only, trained lawyers are concentrated in urban centres, and cloud-dependent AI fails where mobile connectivity is unreliable, a setting in which hallucinated legal text causes direct harm. The system addresses statutory interpretation only; queries that require judicial precedent or case-law reasoning fall outside its scope. We target the statutory access gap by compressing a 9-billion-parameter Gemma-2 teacher into a 2-billion-parameter student through two-phase progressive knowledge distillation. Phase 1 performs supervised fine-tuning on 9,429 quality-gated legal question-answer pairs (65% acceptance from 14,514 generated queries); Phase 2 minimises sparse Kullback-Leibler divergence against the teacher's top-50 per-token logits at temperature tau = 4.0, implemented via QLoRA (4-bit NF4, rank-32 LoRA adapters). Prior legal language models target general legal English; this system specialises in Bangladeshi statutory law. Every response is grounded through hybrid retrieval combining dense semantic search (60%) and BM25 (40%) across 36,029 statutory passages from the Bangladesh Constitution and national legislation. On a 50-query English benchmark, the distilled model reaches ROUGE-L 0.4715 and BERTScore F1 0.5679, a 103% ROUGE-L and 143% BERTScore gain over the retrieval-augmented undistilled baseline (ROUGE-L 0.2323, BERTScore 0.2340). The adapter quantises to 1.6 GB (GGUF Q4_K_M) and runs at 4-8 tokens per second on a Pixel 6 with no network access. Cross-lingual evaluation on 50 Bangla queries yields ROUGE-L 0.4083 and BERTScore 0.8133, showing effective retrieval from Bangla input against an English-only corpus. In a single-evaluator pilot, a practising lawyer rated 50 responses at a weighted mean of 4.16/5 (90% rated 4 or 5), supporting utility beyond text-overlap metrics.
articles.titleCn: 面向孟加拉国法律环境的高效大型语言模型蒸馏：一款适用于智能手机的检索增强生成模型
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉国的法律信息对大多数公民而言难以获取。法规文本仅使用英语，训练有素的律师集中在城市中心，而依赖云端的AI在移动网络连接不可靠的情况下失效——在这种环境下，虚构的法律文本会直接造成危害。该系统仅处理法规解释；需要司法先例或案例法推理的查询则超出其范围。我们通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏，将一个拥有90亿参数的Gemma-2教师模型压缩成一个拥有20亿参数的学生模型，以解决法规获取的鸿沟。第一阶段对9,429对经过质量筛选的法律问答对（从14,514个生成查询中接受率为65%）进行监督微调；第二阶段在温度为4.0时，通过QLoRA（4位NF4，秩为32的LoRA适配器）最小化稀疏Kullback-Leibler散度，针对教师模型每个token的前50个logits。先前的法律语言模型主要针对通用法律英语，而该系统专门针对孟加拉国的法规法律。每个回应都通过混合检索进行基础，结合60%的密集语义搜索和40%的BM25，从孟加拉国宪法和国家立法的36,029段法规文本中进行检索。在一个包含50个查询的英语基准测试中，蒸馏模型达到ROUGE-L 0.4715和BERTScore F1 0.5679，相比检索增强的非蒸馏基线（ROUGE-L 0.2323，BERTScore 0.2340）分别提升了103%和143%。适配器量化为1.6GB（GGUF Q4_K_M），在Pixel 6设备上无需网络连接即可以每秒4-8个token的速度运行。对50个孟加拉语查询进行跨语言评估，得到ROUGE-L 0.4083和BERTScore 0.8133，显示从孟加拉语输入对纯英语语料库的有效检索。在一个单一评估者的试点中，一名执业律师对50个回应的加权平均评分为4.16/5（90%的回应被评为4或5），表明其效用超越了文本重叠指标。

articles.title: TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
articles.abstract: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.
articles.titleCn: TAC-Time：文本作为多模态时间序列预测的渠道
articles.abstractCn: 目前大多数时间序列预测方法仅依赖数值观测，忽略了辅助文本中丰富的上下文信息。近期多模态方法尝试整合文本信号，但它们通常将文本视为静态特征，或使用大型语言模型作为预测骨干，这限制了它们捕捉时间动态的能力并增加了计算成本。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TAC-Time，一个将文本信息转化为额外时间通道的统一框架。通过在共享的时间骨干中联合建模文本特征与数值序列，TAC-Time在保持时间连续性和周期结构的同时，仍保持了高效性和可扩展性。这种表述方式还支持系统性的可解释性分析。我们通过注意力机制和频域分析展示了强烈的跨模态依赖性，并识别出预测性文本信号，其相关性感知对齐带来了部分预测改进。在真实世界多模态基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TAC-Time优于现有方法。

articles.title: Data Agents: Agentic Data Systems
articles.abstract: Traditional data systems face profound limitations in the AI era, relying on human-crafted pipelines, lacking semantic understanding of heterogeneous data, and operating through rigid, reactive processing. To address these challenges, we propose a new paradigm called the Data Agent, designed to manage, process, and analyze data with minimal human intervention. Data agents autonomously execute a wide range of data-related tasks, transforming traditional data systems by shifting from manual design to autonomous orchestration, from literal manipulation to semantic interpretation, and from reactive to proactive processing. Our Data Agent system includes six components: semantic data organization, semantic operators, agentic pipeline orchestration and optimization, feedback-driven refinement, memory management, and proactive adaptation. Building on this foundation, we also develop two specialized agents: the data analytics agent and the data science agent. Experiments on real benchmarks demonstrate significant performance gains of our data agent over state-of-the-art methods. We identify open challenges to guide future research in building fully autonomous data systems.
articles.titleCn: 数据代理：自主数据系统
articles.abstractCn: 传统数据系统在人工智能时代面临深刻局限性，依赖人工构建的管道、缺乏对异构数据的语义理解，以及通过僵化、被动的处理方式运行。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为“数据代理”（Data Agent）的新范式，旨在以极少量人工干预来管理、处理和分析数据。数据代理能够自主执行各类数据相关任务，通过从手动设计转向自主编排、从字面操作转向语义解读、从被动处理转向主动处理，从而变革传统数据系统。我们的数据代理系统包含六个组件：语义数据组织、语义算子、代理管道编排与优化、反馈驱动优化、记忆管理以及主动适应。在此基础上，我们还开发了两种专用代理：数据分析代理和数据科学代理。在真实基准测试上的实验表明，我们的数据代理在性能上显著优于现有最佳方法。我们识别了开放性挑战，以指导未来研究构建完全自主的数据系统。

articles.title: Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.
articles.titleCn: 关于CAP：审计生产RAG管道中的检索覆盖率
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）在生产环境中难以监控：对于实时重新索引的数百万级非平稳语料库，不存在详尽的关联标签。因此，检索质量通常研究不足，且往往优先考虑生成导向指标。在本工作中，我们提出通过探测缺失文档的证据来审计检索覆盖率，而不是枚举每个相关文档。我们的方法Re:CAP（迭代探测的检索覆盖率审计）是一种无参考审计循环，应用于已部署RAG管道的初始答案和检索到的上下文：它识别已覆盖的主题，为可能缺失的主题生成探测问题，检索候选文档，并应用LLM作为裁判，仅保留那些引入先前未检索信息的文档。在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP恢复了平面BM25 top-500无法触及的9-29%的金标准标签，在TREC-COVID上达到48%。在MuSiQue上，Re:CAP在不到一半文档预算的情况下，召回率比平面混合top-500高出12.9个百分点。一个包含BM25、密集和混合基线的集成模型（每个top-500）在TREC-COVID上仍遗漏了21.2%的金标准文档，而Re:CAP成功恢复了这些文档；人工标注员判断其中78.9%（Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79，n = 123）结构不同的文档为基线答案添加了新信息，在实时生产流量中这一比例为73.9%（n = 180）。端到端召回率在三次独立运行中可重复到±1%以内，使Re:CAP成为周期性检索审计的稳定工具。

articles.title: You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From
articles.abstract: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.

articles.titleCn: 你能分辨出是谁提问：网络问题的构成及其来源是什么
articles.abstractCn: 从网络上抓取的问题被学术界和工业界广泛用作衡量人们想了解内容的代理指标。在问答训练数据、检索基准测试和内容策略中，页面上的问题被认为反映了人类意图。我们通过提取110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025年）中的134亿个问题出现次数，在大规模上验证这一假设，并报告了三个发现。首先，可以识别提问者：问题的来源（问题的主机/页面）在问题形式中留下了信号，逻辑回归模型可以通过长度和上下文而非问题类型，将真实用户问题与模板化/制造问题区分开（AUC为0.725），尽管在商业常见问题解答写作方面仅为0.554。其次，问题频率不能衡量需求：最频繁的问题都是陈词滥调/模板化（前一千个中超过70%），出现次数衡量的是字符串发布的频率而非提问的频率。第三，在十二年间，真实问题的比例下降了79%（在控制爬取组成后为42-56%），问题长度和上下文也在减少。我们首次提供了关于网络问题来源的历时性、出现层面的测量，发现可爬取网络中的问题已从人类提问转向为机器阅读而制造。

articles.title: From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning
articles.abstract: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.

articles.titleCn: 从内容生成到学习支持：面向STEM学习的教学指导生成式视频导师
articles.abstractCn: 生成式人工智能能够实现教育视频的可扩展生产，但当前系统主要集中于制作视觉上连贯的内容，而非支持学习。因此，生成的视频往往缺乏明确的教学结构、可靠的质量控制以及评估学习者理解或纠正误解的机制。在这项工作中，我们介绍了PIVOT（基于教学指导的视频教学辅导系统），一个通过以学习为中心的教学支持进行STEM学习的生成式视频辅导框架。1 受传统教学流程的启发，我们的框架将教学法融入整个生成流程：首先使用教学原则指导故事板生成，然后通过以代码为中心的生成和教学法验证 harness 生成经过验证的多模态视频，最后将视频与评估和误解感知的纠正措施连接起来。在四个STEM领域的实验和专家评估表明，我们的框架生成的教育视频具有与教学法一致的内容、清晰且引人入胜的呈现方式、连贯的教学流程，并且被感知为有效的学习工具。这些发现表明，在教育内容生成中应采取以人为本的视角：生成式系统不仅应通过其产出进行评估和设计，还应通过它们对教学实践、学习者理解和纠正反馈的支持程度进行评估和设计。

articles.title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance
articles.abstract: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.
articles.titleCn: 基于状态条件潜在引导与进度引导的有效推理探索
articles.abstractCn: Best-of-$N$ 是一种广泛用于复杂推理的策略，其有效性取决于所采样的候选是否能够覆盖多样化和高质量的推理路径。然而，预训练的推理模型常常遭受 \emph{探索坍塌} 的问题，即独立的 rollout 反复遵循相似的推理路径，从而限制了增加 rollout 预算所带来的收益。现有方法通过促进更广泛的探索来缓解这一问题，但并未明确引导探索朝着能够取得实质性进展的延续方向，导致探索效率有限。为解决此问题，我们提出了 \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS)，一种无需训练的潜空间引导框架。具体而言，SPS 构建了一个状态条件化的方向库，其中包含针对不同前缀状态区域的多条进度引导引导向量。在在线推理过程中，SPS 根据当前的前缀状态检索合适的引导向量，并在高不确定性转换处应用它，以引导下一次推理步骤朝着有意义的进展方向。跨多个模型规模和基准的广泛实验表明，SPS 始终优于强大的基线模型。进一步的分析验证了其关键设计的有效性，并为未来的研究提供了宝贵的见解。代码可在 https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS 获取。

articles.title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
articles.abstract: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.
articles.titleCn: 基于表示的上下文学习用于多模态大语言模型指导下的医学图像解释
articles.abstractCn: 医学图像解读对于诊断和护理至关重要，然而，调整通用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）通常需要资源密集型的特定领域微调。在此，我们介绍了表示引导的上下文学习（RG-ICL），这是一种无需训练的推理框架，它使用冻结的编码器检索与查询对齐的示例，而无需特定任务的参数更新。在涵盖组织病理学、放射学和眼底检查的八个数据集上，RG-ICL在分类（平均提升20个百分点）和视觉问答（VQA）（平均提升13个百分点）方面优于无上下文和传统ICL，接近或超过了基于训练的比较器。检索哪些案例比检索多少案例更重要：6个与查询对齐的案例优于最多32个随机选择的案例，而固定或随机案例往往将准确率降低至基线以下。对于VQA，将参考案例与图像内容和问题意图对齐产生了进一步的提升。这些结果表明，对于医学图像解读，管理MLLM看到的参考案例是一种实用的替代方案，可以重新训练它。

articles.title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
articles.abstract: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.
articles.titleCn: 规模化校准决策：使用系统一模型（Jev）将警方事故叙述转化为概率性事故变量
articles.abstractCn: 包含调查员叙述的事故数据集包含了编码字段所遗漏的信息。在规模上对这些叙述进行编码一直受到三个障碍的阻碍。前沿大型语言模型在该规模下成本高昂，其生成的文本无法验证，而且没有规则规定人类必须检查多少输出。本文将叙述编码表述为受控的类型化决策，由Jev（一个返回概率而非生成文本的系统一模型）来回答。一个屏幕覆盖了49.95万份德克萨斯州叙述，其中19.5857万份使用27个问题的模式进行编码。成本由模式大小而非叙述长度控制。概率值与编码字段和2,416份在规定抽样设计下进行的盲法人类判断进行审计。两个前沿大型语言模型在相同记录上进行基准测试。与人类标签相比，类型化模型达到了0.908的F1值。其中一个前沿模型提高了0.059，另一个则与它无法区分。校准因模型而异而非因范式而异，因此每个模型都必须进行审计。在相同标签上的重新校准将校准误差降低了3.3倍。与编码字段的一致性在kappa值上低估了对叙述的忠实度中位数为0.26。一个分辨率下限约束了任何报告离散网格概率的模型。对标记记录的审查预算给出了每变量每年人类必须阅读的记录数。将校准变量添加到编码字段每年将归因于九个因素的伤害和致命事故提高了10,747起。

articles.title: When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation
articles.abstract: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.
articles.titleCn: 当证据冲突时：可靠性感知元综述生成
articles.abstractCn: 当评审者证据存在冲突且可靠性不同时，从多个同行评审中生成连贯的元评审是一项挑战。现有方法通常将元评审生成表述为多文档摘要任务，并统一聚合评审者反馈，这使得在存在分歧时难以确定应优先考虑哪些观点。在本文中，我们通过可靠性感知的证据聚合研究元评审生成。我们的框架首先从同行评审中提取方面级观点，并识别每个方面的冲突证据。然后，它估计观点级支持和评审级质量以衡量证据可靠性。基于这些信号，框架为评审者反馈分配可靠性感知权重，使生成器能够优先考虑更受支持的论点，同时保留多样化的观点。实验表明，我们的方法在自动和人工评估方面均优于强基线，在高冲突评审场景下在冲突识别和解决方面取得了明显的提升。代码和实现细节可在 https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review 公开获取。

articles.title: AURA: Uncertainty-Routed Activation Editing for Acoustic Grounding in Speech Foundation Models
articles.abstract: Attention encoder-decoder (AED) Speech Foundation Models achieve strong ASR performance but can generate acoustically unsupported text when inputs contain no speech, weak acoustic evidence, or unreliable transcription. We propose AURA: Activation-editing with Uncertainty-Routed Adaptation, an ultra-efficient representation-editing method that freezes the pretrained model and applies sparse scale-and-shift edits to decoder cross-attention heads. AURA dynamically routes edits using cross-attention uncertainty features that capture over-concentration, diffuse attention, and abrupt frame shifts. We evaluate AURA on four datasets spanning non-speech hallucination and speech grounding stressors, including imperfect-label child speech, imperfect-label adult speech, and disfluent speech. On non-speech audio, AURA reduces hallucination rate from 89.18% to 1.94% without prior hallucination-head identification. On imperfect-label corpora, AURA approaches LoRA WER while using roughly 500x fewer trainable parameters. Sensitivity analysis and qualitative cross-attention examples are consistent with AURA's uncertainty-routed editing behavior, supporting dynamic activation editing as a practical path for grounding AED speech models.
articles.titleCn: AURA：用于语音基础模型声学基础定位的不确定性路由激活编辑
articles.abstractCn: 注意力编码器-解码器（AED）语音基础模型在语音识别（ASR）方面表现出色，但在输入包含无声、弱声学证据或不可靠转录时，仍可能生成声学上不支持的文本。我们提出了AURA：不确定性路由自适应的激活编辑方法，这是一种超高效的表示编辑技术，冻结预训练模型，并对解码器交叉注意力头应用稀疏缩放和位移编辑。AURA利用交叉注意力不确定性特征动态路由编辑，这些特征捕捉了过度集中、分散注意力和突发帧偏移。我们在涵盖无声幻觉和语音定位压力因素的四个数据集上评估了AURA，包括不完美标签儿童语音、不完美标签成人语音和犹豫语音。在无声音频上，AURA将幻觉率从89.18%降至1.94%，而无需预先识别幻觉头。在不完美标签语料库中，AURA接近LoRA的WER，同时使用的可训练参数数量减少约500倍。敏感性分析和定性交叉注意力示例均与AURA的不确定性路由编辑行为一致，支持动态激活编辑作为将AED语音模型定位到实际应用的可行路径。

articles.title: From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification
articles.abstract: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.
articles.titleCn: 从表格到量化陈述：通过可执行验证评估大型语言模型的推理生成
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型可以从表格中生成流畅的描述，但它们的输出可能无法得到结构化数据的逻辑支持。我们引入了STAT-TO-TEXT，这是一个受控任务，其中大型语言模型使用“所有”、“一些”、“没有”和“大多数”等量化结构从统计表格中生成量化的自然语言推理。为了评估这些推理，我们使用由大型语言模型生成的Python检查器代码，执行时将对应的真值条件与表格进行验证。我们在不同模型系列和规模下比较了四个开放权重的语言模型，评估了忠实度、逻辑准确性、表格覆盖率和多样性。我们的结果表明，模型规模和系列都很重要，最大的模型（GPT-OSS-120B）始终能产生最忠实的推理，同时不牺牲更大的表格覆盖率和量化多样性，这与较小模型形成对比。这些发现得到了人工标注的支持，人工标注显示自动化检查器与人类判断高度一致。

articles.title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
articles.abstract: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.
articles.titleCn: Open-Jev 在 CallScreenBench 上的判断：使用小型语言模型的校准单次诈骗筛选
articles.abstractCn: 对电话诈骗进行筛查需要每轮通话后都能提供可靠的概率，单位为毫秒。Jev风格的决策机制承诺做到这一点：声明选项输入，经过单次前向传递，每个选项输出一个校准概率，且不生成文本。我们测试了这种读出机制的开源实现JevLite在诈骗电话筛查中的应用：Qwen3-4B经过LoRA微调，使得温度缩放的softmax在两个答案标签logit上输出P(诈骗)。在41个保留的CallScreenBench场景（每场景577个回合决策）中，三种子集达到了AUROC 0.974的校准误差0.052，与预先注册的0.02边际条件下LLM裁判（MiniMax-M3）相当，且合法电话无误报，在相同挂断规则下决策提前1.14回合，在单个消费级GPU上每决策64.5毫秒，比同样骨干网络微调生成答案的方式低4.9倍。优势在于读出和校准，而非准确度：微调的ModernBERT编码器表现没有显著差异，配方选择经过测试集曝光，所有来电者均为合成数据。我们不声称架构创新；贡献在于应用和评估报告，包括AUROC、校准误差、误报和决策时间。

articles.title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs
articles.abstract: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.
articles.titleCn: 某些方言比其他方言更平等：大型语言模型中的非精英阿拉伯方言偏见
articles.abstractCn: 以往关于埃及阿拉伯语在自然语言处理领域的研究主要集中在声望较高的开罗埃及阿拉伯语（CEA）方言上，导致在大型语言模型（LLM）和资源开发方面对声望较低的赛义迪埃及阿拉伯语（SEA）方言缺乏代表性。这种代表性不足是否会影响LLM对SEA（上游）可接受性的看法，以及上游对SEA的偏见是否会导致下游性能更差？我们通过一项目标句法评估（TSE）任务，研究了SEA方言特征对LLM偏好的上游影响，该任务揭示了多个LLM中存在显著的SEA偏见。随后，我们分析了这些特征对MMLU基准测试下游模型性能的影响，并表明当模型遇到SEA时，其性能会下降。这项研究强调了进一步探索方言变体如何影响语言技术的必要性。
